verdict.rationale: Community evidence references GitHub's code search feature (login required to search code, and complaints that its search quality is 'terribly bad' compared to cloning and grepping), which confirms the axis exists but with major usability caveats. No first-party documentation in the evidence pack describes commit/file search functionality or scope. missing for 10: official docs describing repo-wide code/commit search, hands-on evidence of it working well, coverage of file and commit search specifically.
